parsed.scene_description: The image shows the entrance of a building with a large glass door. The door is made of stainless steel and has a handle on the right side. Through the window, we can see a room with a white radiator and a blue sign that reads "Welcome to the building". The room appears to be empty, with no people or other objects visible.
